iteration.notes: Implementation is already correct - drag functionality is working as designed

debugFindings.rootCause: Code implementation is CORRECT - dragging should work with long-press on any item
debugFindings.evidence: Library v0.10.1 uses DraggableSwipeableItem wrapper which enables drag automatically. The dragDropModifier() function mentioned in some docs is from a different version/library.
debugFindings.actualBehavior: Items should be draggable by long-pressing anywhere on the item (except on the Switch itself which consumes tap events)
debugFindings.userInstructions: To drag: Long-press on the text area or drag handle icon, then move the item. Avoid long-pressing directly on the Switch toggle.
debugFindings.conclusion: No code changes required. The implementation follows the library's API correctly for v0.10.1.

summary.findings: Drag-to-reorder is implemented correctly using DragDropSwipeLazyColumn and DraggableSwipeableItem wrapper. The library automatically enables long-press drag on all wrapped items. Users should long-press on areas other than the Switch to initiate drag.
summary.recommendation: Current implementation is correct. If users report issues, suggest: 1) Long-press on the text area or drag handle, not the Switch, 2) Ensure they're using the latest app version, 3) Test on device (vs emulator) which may have better touch sensitivity.
